name: Preloop
description: Expose OpenClaw to Preloop for discovery, status, Agent Control, voice-transcript delivery, and native tool-call approval on mobile/watch.

enabled.description: Set to false to keep the plugin installed but inactive.

protocol.description: Agent Control protocol version, for example preloop.agent_control.v1.

runtime.description: Runtime identifier reported to Preloop. Defaults to openclaw.

bearer_token.description: Runtime bearer token minted by the Preloop CLI or marketplace installer. Do not hand-author.

runtime_principal_id.description: Preloop runtime principal id for this OpenClaw instance.

runtime_principal_name.description: Optional human-readable name for this runtime principal.

session_reference.description: Optional session reference used to correlate an existing Preloop session.

tool_approval_enabled.description: Gate the native before_tool_call approval hook. Defaults to true.

tool_approval_fail_open.description: When the permission-check endpoint is unreachable, allow the tool to run instead of blocking. Defaults to false (fail closed).

permission_check_url.description: Override for the permission-check endpoint. Derived from control_ws_url when omitted.

adapter_package.description: npm package name of the runtime adapter that owns this entry.

session_source_type.description: Preloop session source type for this runtime.

managed_agent_id.description: Preloop managed agent id, when provisioned by the CLI.

credential_id.description: Preloop credential id bound to this runtime.

credential_name.description: Human-readable name of the bound Preloop credential.

runtime_session_id.description: Preloop runtime session id issued at bootstrap.

session_source_id.description: Preloop session source id issued at bootstrap.
